backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing user profiles, admin allowlist, signup workflows, role assignment, and service report storage with admin-protected reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing a feature update to the Android TWA build guide, listing affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files including hooks, components, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide detailing how to build an Android Trusted Web Activity app, including required Bubblewrap prompt values, icon URLs, and pre-build verification steps.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for running the app on the Internet Computer, covering local development, mainnet deployment, upgrades, smoke tests, and rollback steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH-driven color variables for light and dark themes and applying global background and text styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting metadata, icons, manifest link, and loading the main frontend script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, theme colors, start URL, and icon paths for 192x192 and 512x512 Android assets.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a service worker with precaching, runtime caching, and network-first or cache-first strategies for different request types.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the root app logic handling authentication, profile loading, error states, and routing UI transitions.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Shows an access-denied message for non-admin users with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the main header with navigation, user identity display, copy-to-clipboard actions, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides page layout with header, offline banner, footer, and content wrapper.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays login and signup options using Internet Identity and handles stale session logout.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an alert banner when the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Implements the user profile creation form with validation and role-specific signup handling.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session-invalid message and offers a full logout to reset authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine that clears identity, session storage, React Query cache, and reloads the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements context and provider for managing Internet Identity login state, loading, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks browser online/offline status and updates a boolean accordingly.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching user data, admin checks, signup, and other backend interactions using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with industrial color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting users, purging data, and performing system reset with UI dialogs and checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed report information with loading, error states, and navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating service reports with validation, state handling, and report submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Displays report history with search, filtering, CSV download, and user/admin-specific actions.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects missing-profile and authentication-related errors using pattern checks.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears localStorage and sessionStorage keys related to Internet Identity sessions.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using modern APIs with a fallback method.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides helper functions to shorten or return full principal IDs for display.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts reports to CSV and triggers a browser download with a generated filename.
Extracts and sanitizes backend signup errors and maps them to user‑friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes and logs signup flow data while redacting sensitive information.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Provides validation helpers for required fields, email format, and mobile number formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Offers utilities to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based query cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, plugins, and container settings for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requests, and configuration for building an Android TWA with custom icons.
